title: Interpreting the scoranet diagnostic figures
text: plot_comparison_overview(de_list, go_list, net_list) shows. cell type, three panels bar counts: read . biology? Cell types many DEGs many enriched terms comparison clearest effect. Direction imbalance. cell type whose DEGs almost one colour responds mostly one direction. Consider running ORA split_direction = TRUE , minority direction isn’t drowned . Many DEGs terms. DEGs may biologically scattered, may poorly annotated GO, universe may narrow. Check run_go_ora() QC table. DEGs many terms. small set genes falls many related GO terms (often one large family, ribosomal histone genes). Check driver-gene plot trusting terms. Terms network clusters. terms don’t share enough genes connect current overlap threshold (see section 2). Caveats. DEG counts depend strongly cells per group. cell type 2,000 cells find DEGs one 50, even effect size. Don’t compare raw counts across cell types measured effect strength. number network clusters depends resolution. clusters “biology”.

title: Interpreting the scoranet diagnostic figures
text: plot_overlap_threshold(net_result) shows. Two panels. Top: histogram pairwise Jaccard overlaps. every pair enriched terms share least one DE gene, Jaccard overlap shared genes / total distinct genes. dashed line overlap_threshold used build network: pairs become edges. subtitle reports many term pairs share gene. Bottom: threshold keep. Across range thresholds: Kept (green): terms least one edge. Dropped (isolates) (orange): terms edge. removed network entirely: don’t appear network plots, go_term_df, driver genes, wordclouds. Edges (right panel): number connections. read . threshold sit orange line rises. many terms dropped threshold, discarding enriched biology. Lower threshold, accept terms unrelated rest. Watch edge count. low threshold connects almost everything one hairball, Leiden little structure work . high threshold leaves disconnected fragments. good threshold keeps nearly terms cutting edges well maximum. histogram usually falls just large mass small overlaps (pairs sharing one gene many). Steps curves normal. small gene sets, Jaccard values take limited set values (1/5, 1/4, 1/3, …), histogram gaps curves move jumps. Typical values. 0.1 0.3 data sets. default 0.1. change. overlap_threshold run_comparison_networks().

title: Interpreting the scoranet diagnostic figures
text: plot_leiden_sweep(net_result) shows. network re-clustered resolution, 10 different seeds . Three panels share x axis (resolution). dashed line marks resolution network built . read . Look plateau: stretch resolutions cluster count flat, modularity high roughly flat, stability close 1 narrow band. resolution inside plateau gives clusters reflect real structure network rather particular seed exact resolution chose. dashed line sits steep part cluster-count curve, small changes resolution change clusters: move onto plateau. Interpreting panels together. Rising cluster count, falling modularity. Clusters split past network’s natural structure. Go lower. Stability dips wide band. resolution, different seeds give different clusters: partition ambiguous. Avoid resolutions. Stability 1 extremes meaningful . low resolution everything merges one clusters, high resolution clusters approach single terms. perfectly reproducible uninformative. Always read stability together cluster count modularity. Modularity peak. resolution highest modularity reasonable default clear plateau. Modularity values. 0.3 suggests meaningful community structure; GO overlap networks often 0.5 0.8, related terms form tight groups. change. leiden_resolution run_comparison_networks(). Notes. default objective modularity, resolutions around 1 standard (default 1). objective_function = "CPM", resolution means something different (edge-density cutoff) needs much smaller values, 0.01 0.1. Pass resolutions = seq(0.005, 0.1, = 0.005) sweep case. Clustering seeded (seed = 1234), rerunning gives clusters. sweep varies seed deliberately, test much result change without fixed seed. Networks nodes can’t swept meaningfully; wrapper skips message.

title: Interpreting the scoranet diagnostic figures
text: plot_driver_genes(net_result, de_df) shows. Leiden cluster (columns), top_n DE genes (rows) appear cluster’s GO terms. Dot size share cluster’s terms contain gene. 100% means gene every term cluster. Dot colour gene’s log2 fold change (red = numerator, blue = denominator). Grey de_df supplied. read . Name module genes, terms. GO term names generic (“regulation cellular process”); driver genes say actually changing. Large dots one two genes mean cluster exists genes annotated many terms. cluster may represent one gene’s annotation breadth rather coordinated program. Treat care. Many medium dots mean cluster supported broad set genes shared across terms: convincing module. Mixed colours within cluster mean genes move directions. matches grey (mixed) node colour network plot common regulatory programs. gene driving several clusters (appears one column) links modules. may one program Leiden split; try lower resolution. Watch housekeeping families. Ribosomal (Rpl/Rps), mitochondrial (mt-), histone genes can dominate clusters sheer annotation volume, can reflect technical differences samples. Rows ordered first cluster gene drives, plot reads roughly along diagonal. change. top_n fewer genes per cluster.

title: Interpreting the scoranet diagnostic figures
text: network gets three plots layout ($plots network result, also saved PNGs). plain leiden, node shape also shows direction (circle = , square = , diamond = mixed). three, edge width shows Jaccard overlap node size shows number DE genes term. direction z-score. term, z = (n_up - n_down) / sqrt(n_up + n_down), using term’s DE genes. combines consistently genes move many genes support : term 9 1 genes: z = 2.5 (clearly ). term 3 2 : z = 0.45 (mixed). term single gene: z = 1.0 (, weakly supported). Terms called |z| least zscore_threshold (default 1) mixed otherwise. Raise (example 2) stricter direction calls. output tables also keep mean median log2 fold change term. mean can pulled opposite direction one gene extreme fold change; median z-score robust. split_direction = TRUE every term _up network every term _down network , plain zscore plots single colour. Use leiden plot driver genes networks.

title: Example: Interferon-Beta Stimulated PBMCs
text: compare stimulated (STIM) control (CTRL) cells three cell types. output files go temporary folder.
code: library(scoranet) library(Seurat) library(SeuratData) library(org.Hs.eg.db) data("ifnb") ifnb <- UpdateSeuratObject(ifnb) ifnb <- NormalizeData(ifnb, verbose = FALSE)  table(ifnb$seurat_annotations, ifnb$stim)[c("CD14 Mono", "CD4 Naive T", "B"), ] #>               #>               CTRL STIM #>   CD14 Mono   2215 2147 #>   CD4 Naive T  978 1526 #>   B            407  571 cell_types <- c("CD14 Mono", "CD4 Naive T", "B") out_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "ifnb_results")

title: Example: Interferon-Beta Stimulated PBMCs
text: run_cluster_de() runs Seurat::FindMarkers() within cell type prints short summary per cluster. cell type returns two tables: degs (genes passing adjusted p-value fold-change cutoffs) tested (every gene FindMarkers tested). strongest changes classic interferon-stimulated genes chemokines (CCL8, CXCL10, ISG15, IFIT family), exactly interferon-beta induce. CD14 monocytes respond strongly: half tested genes DEGs. write_de() saves tables per cell type:
code: de_results <- run_cluster_de(   obj         = ifnb,   clusters    = cell_types,   cluster_col = "seurat_annotations",   ident_col   = "stim",   ident1      = "STIM",   ident2      = "CTRL" ) #> i Running DE for "CD14 Mono" (STIM vs CTRL) #> v Running DE for "CD14 Mono" (STIM vs CTRL) [6.3s] #>  #> * Tested genes: 1408 #> * DEGs: 704 #> * Up in STIM: 330 #> * Up in CTRL: 374 #>  #> i Running DE for "CD4 Naive T" (STIM vs CTRL) #> v Running DE for "CD4 Naive T" (STIM vs CTRL) [935ms] #>  #> * Tested genes: 526 #> * DEGs: 202 #> * Up in STIM: 160 #> * Up in CTRL: 42 #>  #> i Running DE for "B" (STIM vs CTRL) #> v Running DE for "B" (STIM vs CTRL) [657ms] #>  #> * Tested genes: 812 #> * DEGs: 263 #> * Up in STIM: 187 #> * Up in CTRL: 76 #> names(de_results[["CD14 Mono"]]) #> [1] "degs"   "tested"  c(degs = nrow(de_results[["CD14 Mono"]]$degs),   tested = nrow(de_results[["CD14 Mono"]]$tested)) #>   degs tested  #>    704   1408 top_degs <- de_results[["CD14 Mono"]]$degs top_degs <- top_degs[order(-abs(top_degs$avg_log2FC)), ] knitr::kable(   head(top_degs[, c("gene", "avg_log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "p_val_adj", "res")], 10),   digits = 3, row.names = FALSE ) write_de(de_results, outSubDir = paste0(out_dir, "/DE/")) list.files(file.path(out_dir, "DE")) #> [1] "B_DE_Results.csv"             "B_tested_genes.csv"           #> [3] "CD14_Mono_DE_Results.csv"     "CD14_Mono_tested_genes.csv"   #> [5] "CD4_Naive_T_DE_Results.csv"   "CD4_Naive_T_tested_genes.csv"

title: Example: Interferon-Beta Stimulated PBMCs
text: run_go_ora() runs clusterProfiler::enrichGO() cell type’s DEGs. cell type’s tested genes used background (use_tested_universe = TRUE), genes never tested DEGs. element standard clusterProfiler enrichResult: top terms antiviral cytokine responses. QC summary many gene sets tested retained written run: CD14 monocytes DEGs fewest enriched terms. tested-gene background, half background genes DEGs, term needs large share DEGs stand . tested-gene universe appropriately conservative, lack signal. write_go() saves results, adding numeric gene-ratio columns:
code: go_results <- run_go_ora(   de_list             = de_results,   org_db              = org.Hs.eg.db,   use_tested_universe = TRUE,   ont                 = "BP",   outputDir           = paste0(out_dir, "/ORA/") ) #>  #>  #> -- GO set: CD14 Mono -- #>  #> Genesets tested: 2846 #> After filtering: 44 #> Retention proportion: 0.015 #>  #> -- GO set: CD4 Naive T -- #>  #> Genesets tested: 1520 #> After filtering: 65 #> Retention proportion: 0.043 #>  #> -- GO set: B -- #>  #> Genesets tested: 1940 #> After filtering: 90 #> Retention proportion: 0.046 go_cd14 <- as.data.frame(go_results[["CD14 Mono"]]) knitr::kable(   head(go_cd14[, c("Description", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio", "p.adjust", "Count")], 10),   digits = 8, row.names = FALSE ) knitr::kable(read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "ORA", "GO_ORA_QC_summary.csv"), row.names = 1)) write_go(go_results, outSubDir = paste0(out_dir, "/ORA/")) list.files(file.path(out_dir, "ORA")) #> [1] "B_GO_ORA_Results.csv"           "CD14_Mono_GO_ORA_Results.csv"   #> [3] "CD4_Naive_T_GO_ORA_Results.csv" "GO_ORA_QC_summary.csv"

title: Single-Cell Gene Ontology Over-Representation Networks
text: Single-cell experiments often produce hundreds differentially expressed genes per cell type, gene ontology (GO) -representation analysis genes can return dozens overlapping, redundant terms. scoranet (Single-Cell -Representation Analysis NETworks) turns list map biological programs help make sense results! [!IMPORTANT] scoranet compatible Seurat v4 v5! cell type, scoranet: Tests differential expression two conditions within cluster Runs GO -representation analysis DEGs, optionally using genes actually tested background, optionally splitting - -regulated genes. Builds pathway overlap network, connecting GO terms share DE genes via Jaccard similarity index, groups modules Leiden clustering. Names module using higher-level terms GO hierarchy, colours terms whether genes go , , . Checks settings built-diagnostics overlap threshold, Leiden resolution, genes driving module help fine-tune figures biological interpretation. plots returned editable ggplot2 objects, every table written disk. DependenciesCRAN: Seurat, cli, dplyr, ggforce, ggplot2, ggraph, ggwordcloud, igraph (>= 2.1.0), patchwork, scales, stringr, withrBioconductor: clusterProfiler, GO.db, AnnotationDbi, organism annotation package (org.Mm.eg.db mouse org.Hs.eg.db human)

title: Build Network Input Data from GO Enrichment and DE Results — build_network_inputs

Large positive values mean term's genes consistently ; values near 0 mean mixed. values 0 term DE genes. de_genes Character vector unique DE gene symbols. Returns NULL significant terms pass filtering.

Names must match rownames(results_set). de_genes Character vector differentially expressed gene symbols. Gene sets collection intersected vector computing overlaps. collection_name Character label used plot titles console output. Typically formatted "<comparison>_<celltype>" (e.g., "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo_Fibroblast_1"). overlap_threshold Numeric [0, 1]. Jaccard coefficient edges set zero. Default 0.1. leiden_resolution Numeric. Resolution Leiden clustering. default modularity objective, values around 1 standard; higher values give , smaller clusters. Use plot_leiden_sweep choose value. Default 1. objective_function Character. Leiden objective passed igraph::cluster_leiden: "modularity" (default; resolution comparable across networks) "CPM" (constant Potts model; resolution acts edge-density cutoff needs much smaller values, e.g. 0.03). seed Integer seed Leiden clustering plot layout, results reproducible. change random state session. NULL disables seeding. Default 1234. outdir Character path output directory. NULL, files written. directory created exist. plot_to_screen Logical. NULL (default), parsed collection_name around "_vs_". zscore_threshold Numeric. node called "" direction z-score least value, "" minus value, "mixed" otherwise. Default 1. theme_label Character. Text used label cluster themes plot: "ancestor" (default) theme_max_ancestors higher-level GO terms cluster's terms fall GO hierarchy (via GO.db), many cluster's terms cover, e.g. "cytokine production / response cytokine       (22/39)". chosen cover many remaining terms staying specific. Falls back hub term ancestor qualifies results GO IDs. "keywords" distinctive words cluster's term names. "phrase" top term name, used wordclouds. "hub" cluster's connected term. theme_min_terms Integer. Clusters fewer terms get hull callout label themes plot, limit clutter. still listed colour-coded cluster legend. Default 3. theme_n_words Integer. Number keywords per cluster label theme_label = "keywords". Default 3. theme_ancestor_min_share Numeric (0, 1]. Minimum share cluster's terms ancestor must cover used label. Default 0.15. theme_ancestor_max_size Integer. GO terms descendants considered generic label (reference: "cell cycle" 800, "response stress" 1,300, "cellular process" 16,000). Default 1000. theme_max_ancestors Integer. Maximum number ancestors one cluster label. Default 2.

title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
text: NULL (message) two terms overlap overlap_threshold. Otherwise list following elements: network igraph graph object vertex attributes fc, regulation, size, cluster, color, shape. clustering communities object returned igraph::cluster_leiden. overlap_matrix Square numeric matrix pairwise Jaccard coefficients (thresholding). go_term_df Data frame columns go_term, cluster, degree, regulation ("", "", "mixed"), avg_log2FC (mean), median_log2FC, n_up, n_down, zscore, go_id, leiden_resolution. direction columns NA results_set z-score columns, go_id NA GO IDs. cluster_stats Data frame columns cluster, avg_degree, n_terms. leiden_resolution, objective_function, overlap_threshold, seed settings used. term_genes Named list: node (GO term), DE genes contains. Used plot_driver_genes. cluster_themes Data frame one row per Leiden cluster: cluster, n_terms; shared GO ancestors (ancestor, names joined " / "; ancestor_id, IDs joined ";"; ancestor_n_covered, many cluster's terms fall ; NA none qualifies); candidate labels keywords, phrase, hub. plots list ggplot objects built ggraph: plain (nodes filled direction: , , mixed), leiden (nodes filled Leiden cluster, cluster legend left), zscore (nodes filled continuous blue-white-red gradient direction z-score). plain leiden, node shape shows direction (circle = ident1, square = ident2, diamond = mixed). Edge width shows Jaccard overlap. Cluster colours come 40-colour dittoSeq palette. themes Leiden plot annotated cluster themes: shaded hull around cluster callout naming theme, layout keeps cluster together (node positions differ plots). zscore NULL results_set zscore column.

title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
